Red herring
LOGICAL FALLACY
Diverting attention from the issue under dispute to a related but less relevant point, leaving the original challenge insufficiently answered.
The response shifts from pervasive cosmic lethality to grandeur, intimacy, and whether humans require a maximally comfortable universe.
